title: Jamaican Jerk Tiger Prawns
description: Crispy prawns with aromatic Jamaican jerk spices, served as a Chinese-inspired appetizer.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, soy sauce, and Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Add the mixture to the prawns and toss to coat.
Heat coconut oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Transfer the prawns to a baking sheet and top with grated cheese.
Bake for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Sprinkle with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
In a small saucepan, heat the remaining coconut oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Serve the prawns with the garlic-ginger sauce on the side.
